about: Organizations whose public work relates to a kind of change in a place, each with a public page. Listed by Threadlands after checking their own site; being listed does not mean they have endorsed, or taken on, any idea here. An idea's path says 'Connected with a group' only when that group has agreed.

fields.name: group or campaign name
fields.topic: topics from assets/propose.js (food, mobility, trees, heat, water, parks, safety, waste, air)
fields.what: one line on what they do
fields.type: pilot kind of change this relates to (cycling, food, shade-water)
fields.checked: month their public page was checked

groups.name: Bicitekas
groups.what: Nonprofit working on urban cycling and sustainable mobility since 1998: group rides, road safety and public policy.

groups.name: Alimento para Todos
groups.what: Mexico City food bank that recovers food fit to eat and supplies it to people and institutions facing food insecurity.

groups.name: Cultiva Ciudad (Huerto Tlatelolco)
groups.what: Urban-agriculture organization running Huerto Tlatelolco, a community garden with workshops, school visits and a volunteer program.

groups.name: Reforestamos México
groups.what: Nonprofit working on forests and, through its Árboles y Ciudades program, on urban trees in Mexican cities.

groups.name: Isla Urbana
groups.what: Designs and installs rainwater-harvesting systems, mainly where people lack reliable water, including in Mexico City.
